title: News
description: A news reader app for the glasses: fetches current top headlines from a free RSS feed (e.g. BBC News, AP, or Google News RSS), shows a scrollable list of headlines, and selecting one shows the story's summary/description text paginated for the small monochrome display. Include a refresh option and a few category options (top, world, tech, sports).
